findings.message: The select:comandaReview entry behavior had no declared selection writer; added public selectComandaReview(id) with null clearing and record loading.
The payment form had no declared draft state source; added FecharComandaPagaDraft, fecharComandaPagaInput, and setFecharComandaPaga.
Closing removes the returned closed comanda from openComandas and upserts the returned comanda into comanda as declared.
public fecharComandaPagaInput is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
public selectComandaReview is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
